sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 24.31 per unit, before any margin (cost:340010).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Our forecast for this part shows a recorded change of +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).
Could you lift your allocation to 22230 units per year?
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Further price reductions are not feasible given our current capacity utilisation.

We can accommodate the volume increase to 23,400 units per year under a 24-month contract. In consideration of this volume and the extended lead time of 56 days, we propose a unit price of €31.70. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your message. Our proposed terms are in the term sheet of this message.
Your on-time delivery averaged 80.7% over the last 4 quarters (sc:70410@2026Q3, sc:70410@2026Q2, sc:70410@2026Q1, sc:70410@2025Q4).
We placed our last 3 orders for this part at EUR 29.89 per unit (po:4500014436-10, po:4500014383-10, po:4500014337-10).
We noted the report "Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH allocates volumes" (news:20260822-23).
Could you explain the reason behind the limit you stated?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We received a lot of material and looked at what bears on this part. We checked the news data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also verified your data regarding past orders and delivery performance; they do not affect our calculation for this part. 

Our current capacity utilisation dictates the limits we stated. This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. We propose an adjustment to a price of €31.60 per unit for a contract term of 24 months at a volume of 23400 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
